bulk_proteomics.allowed_input: PXD051911 participant-level protein quantities in their frozen assay-native representation.
bulk_proteomics.prohibited: No donor-matched RNA-protein training, imputation of absent proteins as zero, transcript-level normalization ported to protein values, or protein evidence treated as technical replicates.

bulk_rna.allowed_input: Participant-level assay-native bulk RNA matrix with cohort provenance, observed library metadata, and explicit feature coverage.
bulk_rna.blocked_choice: Exact count or transformed unit, gene filtering, library normalization, cohort scaling, covariates, feature harmonization, and frozen program projection are not yet registered for these baselines.
bulk_rna.fold_rule: Any learned gene filter, scale, covariate coefficient, reference mean, program mapping, or calibration uses training participants only.

celltypist_rna.allowed_input: RNA expression normalized by library size to 10000 and log1p for AnnData-based custom training and prediction, with the same frozen training-derived gene axis.
celltypist_rna.fit_rule: Train a new classifier within each donor outer fold. Freeze centering, solver, C or SGD parameters, balancing, feature selection, seed, calibration, and majority-vote policy.
celltypist_rna.pretrained_policy: Built-in or downloaded CellTypist classifiers are prohibited for this baseline.

harmony_rna.allowed_input: A training-derived normalized expression or PCA matrix plus prespecified batch variables.
harmony_rna.disposition: The registered release has no admitted frozen-query mapping; a joint train-query run is a transductive diagnostic and cannot be a sealed champion.

algorithms.hvg_pca_elastic_net: Multinomial elastic-net logistic regression; C=1; l1_ratio=0.5; SAGA; max_iter=5000.
algorithms.hvg_pca_knn: 15-neighbor Euclidean donor/class-weighted vote; canonical-row tie break.
algorithms.hvg_pca_linear_svm: Linear SVM with donor-grouped three-fold out-of-fold multinomial logistic calibration.
algorithms.hvg_pca_logistic: Multinomial L2 logistic regression; C=1; LBFGS; max_iter=5000.
algorithms.hvg_pca_nearest_centroid: Donor/class-weighted centroids, squared Euclidean distance, and training-derived softmax temperature.

hvg_pca_rna.allowed_input: Nonnegative integer cell or nucleus UMI counts with versionless Ensembl gene IDs.
hvg_pca_rna.training_only_transform: Scale each cell to 10000 counts and log1p; select 2000 HVGs by rank-binned normalized dispersion with 20 mean bins; fit centered full SVD with at most 50 PCs; fit all downstream state only on outer-training donors.
hvg_pca_rna.weighting: Equal class mass and equal donor mass within class.

pca_procrustes_and_cca_rna.blocked_choice: No implementation, feature axis, normalization, regularization, anchor topology, projection direction, head, or held-query policy has been frozen.
pca_procrustes_and_cca_rna.fold_rule: A future champion path must learn every projection and alignment from training donors only; held-query geometry cannot determine the transform.

rna_atac_pseudobulk.allowed_training_input: GSE296875 donor-by-cell-state RNA and ATAC summaries constructed from admitted same-nucleus records after donor mapping, Tn5 processing, peak-universe, and QC locks.
rna_atac_pseudobulk.blocked_choice: The predictive rule, assay-native ATAC normalization, count/profile output, low-depth behavior, and missing-state fallback are unresolved. Pseudobulk aggregation alone is not a prediction model.
rna_atac_pseudobulk.development_topology: GSE244832 permits same-donor comparison only and never artificial cell-to-cell RNA-ATAC pairs.
rna_atac_pseudobulk.inference_input: Observed held-donor RNA/context and sequence only. Observed held ATAC is evaluator-only.

scvi_scanvi_rna.allowed_input: Raw UMI counts in a frozen layer with a training-derived Ensembl gene universe.
scvi_scanvi_rna.blocked_choice: Freeze batch key, categorical and continuous covariates, gene selection, architecture, likelihood, label ontology for scANVI, downstream head for scVI, seeds, early stopping, query mapping, calibration, and fitted-state format.
scvi_scanvi_rna.query_rule: The current benchmark permits no query training or domain adaptation on held features. Official query-adaptive scArches runs may be reported only under a separately frozen transductive diagnostic contract.

crosswalk_scope.purpose: Bind the thirteen classical or locally trained cell and bulk baselines to the currently registered task, data-topology, leakage, and adoption requirements without turning unresolved registry rows into runnable models.

data_and_split_contract.fold_rule: All libraries, tissues, timepoints, sections, images, spots, cells, and modalities from one person remain in one outer role.
data_and_split_contract.held_labels: Visible only in an isolated evaluator after prediction hashes are committed.
data_and_split_contract.inner_selection: Every normalization, feature selection, batch correction, alignment, latent model, classifier, centroid, prototype, calibration model, hyperparameter choice, and domain adaptation step is fit inside the outer training partition.
data_and_split_contract.unit_warning: Cells and nuclei contribute measurements and donor-balanced prediction summaries; they are not independent biological replicates.

explicit_missingness_contract.model_input: Every model receives an explicit assay and evidence mask when its interface supports missing modalities.
explicit_missingness_contract.numeric_zero: A zero is a measured assay value only when the assay was observed and its native representation defines zero. Missing, withheld, untestable, unavailable, and non-applicable evidence never become numeric zero.
explicit_missingness_contract.outcome_denominator: Only donors with an observed and prespecified endpoint enter that endpoint. Endpoint missingness cannot be converted to a negative label.

gse296875_phenotype_interpretation.allowed: Use donor-linked numeric macrovesicular steatosis and prespecified any-versus-no-significant-fibrosis mappings only as cross-fitted development secondary endpoints or error-audit strata.
gse296875_phenotype_interpretation.not_allowed: Do not label GSE296875 donors as MASLD controls or cases, MASH, NAS classes, or fibrosis stages unless such fields are explicitly present in a frozen source authority.
gse296875_phenotype_interpretation.reason: The current TaskSpecs register donor histopathology fields, not a complete MASLD diagnostic phenotype.

open_champion_contract.baseline_comparator_policy: Select the candidate with the strongest prospectively frozen development endpoint. Compare it with the strongest eligible prespecified baseline after excluding the selected model. A baseline may be the winner. If no distinct eligible comparator remains, make no superiority claim. Negative controls are never champions or champion baselines.
open_champion_contract.bulk: No baseline in this bundle can currently earn an open bulk champion. All five task baselines lack a bulk execution contract, and GSE267031 must first pass the outcome-blind 80% power gate.
open_champion_contract.cell: The five project HVG/PCA baselines are technically eligible for cell-state selection. scVI, scANVI, and CellTypist remain blocked. PCA-Procrustes and CCA are not in the current TaskSpec baseline roster. A task champion still requires project-sealed GSE289173 success, a clean exposure disposition, selection lock, and releaseable code and fitted state.
open_champion_contract.license: A package license is necessary but insufficient. Release also requires dependency notices, project implementation terms, input-data and trained-weight review, environment and artifact locks, model card, predictions, and checksums.
open_champion_contract.no_universal_claim: A win applies only to the task and seal that satisfy their own gate; there is no aggregate classical-baseline champion.
open_champion_contract.rna_conditioned_atac: No MASLD champion is possible from the current development-only evidence. The assay-native pseudobulk row is also unimplemented.

reproducibility_contract.common_receipt: Hash dataset view, admitted donor rows, feature axis, masks, split, every fold-fitted transform, algorithm parameters, package and code lock, seed, fitted state, predictions, calibration, and terminal disposition.
reproducibility_contract.fitted_state_scope: outer_fold plus seed plus task plus dataset-view hash
reproducibility_contract.immutability: No fitted state or results directory is overwritten. A correction creates a new campaign revision.
reproducibility_contract.seed_policy: One fixed seed for smoke, three fixed seeds for screening, five fixed seeds for finalists. Seeds measure numerical stability and are not biological replicates.

scientific_claim_limits.bulk: Use cross-sectional stage-associated remodeling, never longitudinal progression.
scientific_claim_limits.cell: Disease/control utility is secondary donor-level research performance, never a diagnostic claim.
scientific_claim_limits.resource_firewall: Model results cannot change the Resource evidence classes, thresholds, figures, Gene Catalog, or frozen 117 programs.
scientific_claim_limits.rna_atac: A pseudobulk or context baseline predicts assay profiles; it does not establish causal regulation.

bulk_state_transfer.endpoint: Participant-level transfer of frozen cell-state or program representations to bulk RNA and independent-cohort proteomics; report cross-sectional MASLD stage-associated remodeling only.
bulk_state_transfer.missingness: Keep absent assay, absent endpoint, below-QC protein, and unpaired cohort status explicit.
bulk_state_transfer.multiplicity: Holm FWER 0.05 for the one confirmatory external champion hypothesis; BH q<0.05 within each prespecified secondary endpoint family.
bulk_state_transfer.power_and_champion_gate: Before any GSE267031 outcome is read, freeze paired development variance and demonstrate prospective 80% power for a 0.05 rank-correlation gain. If activated, require observed gain >=0.05, paired 95% lower bound above zero, and no direction reversal. Otherwise no bulk champion is possible.
bulk_state_transfer.topology: same_study_unpaired for the independent RNA and protein cohorts

cell_state_mapping.endpoint: Map RNA-profiled cells or nuclei to the frozen broad_liver_five_v1 identity while aggregating every inferential endpoint to donors.
cell_state_mapping.multiplicity: Holm FWER 0.05 for the one confirmatory external champion hypothesis; BH q<0.05 within the secondary cell-state family.
cell_state_mapping.promotion_gate: On project-sealed GSE289173 require macro-F1 >=0.70, absolute gain >=0.02 over the prespecified strongest comparator, paired 95% lower bound above zero, every evaluable class F1 >=0.50, and multiclass Brier score no worse by more than 0.01.

rna_conditioned_atac.endpoint: Predict donor-by-cell-state ATAC profiles from sequence and observed RNA/context without exposing observed held-donor ATAC at inference.
rna_conditioned_atac.multiplicity: Holm FWER 0.05 only if an eligible external seal activates; BH q<0.05 for development secondary families.
rna_conditioned_atac.promotion_gate: A development winner needs at least 5% relative profile-deviance reduction over the strongest admitted specialist, improvement in at least four of five major lineages, and no lineage worse by more than 2%. It remains retrospective unless FNIH becomes an eligible public seal before selection lock.
rna_conditioned_atac.resampling: 10000 paired two-way donor by genomic-block bootstrap replicates

transductive_inductive_disposition.assay_native_pseudobulk: Unresolved. Donor aggregation is inductive, but held-cohort normalization, a target-derived peak universe, or reading held ATAC would make the run transductive or directly leaky.
transductive_inductive_disposition.cca: Unresolved. Joint train-query CCA is transductive; a champion path must freeze projections using training donors only.
transductive_inductive_disposition.celltypist_baseline: Inductive only for the fold-trained classifier with query-dependent majority voting disabled. Majority-vote output is a separate transductive diagnostic.
transductive_inductive_disposition.harmony_logistic: Transductive diagnostic only under the registered package and current adapter absence.
transductive_inductive_disposition.hvg_pca_elastic_net: Inductive for the current cell-state execution contract.
transductive_inductive_disposition.hvg_pca_knn: Inductive for the current cell-state execution contract.
transductive_inductive_disposition.hvg_pca_linear_svm: Inductive for the current cell-state execution contract, including training-only inner calibration.
transductive_inductive_disposition.hvg_pca_logistic: Inductive for the current cell-state execution contract.
transductive_inductive_disposition.hvg_pca_nearest_centroid: Inductive for the current cell-state execution contract.
transductive_inductive_disposition.mean_expression_bulk: Unresolved. It can be inductive only if all means and transforms are frozen from training participants.
transductive_inductive_disposition.pca_procrustes: Unresolved. Any Procrustes fit using held-query anchors or geometry is transductive.
transductive_inductive_disposition.scanvi_baseline: Blocked until a no-query-training path is frozen; official query-model training is transductive domain adaptation.
transductive_inductive_disposition.scvi_baseline: Blocked until a no-query-training frozen-encoder path is frozen; query-model training is transductive domain adaptation.
